chunks: A fountain from which only they who are honoured drink.

key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبُونَ: The Muqarrabun (those brought near to God)

ai.seo_question: What do the Muqarrabun drink in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the spring of Kawthar granted to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), from which the Muqarrabun drink, symbolizing the culmination of spiritual proximity through divine grace. Scholars emphasize that this drink is not merely physical but represents the pure, unadulterated knowledge and love of God, distinguishing the elite servants who have attained nearness through both faith and righteous action. This highlights the hierarchical nature of Paradise, where the reward of the closest ones transcends the general blessings of the righteous.
